name: Athrikus Narassin's Head
summary: At the Tower of Althalaxx, Athrikus Narassin's Head proves the ancient warlock is dead. The coven's demonic work in northern Darkshore has been disrupted.

sections.title: Blight Upon Althalaxx
sections.body: Athrikus Narassin led dark sorcerers from the Tower of Althalaxx. His coven practiced fel magic along the Darkshore coast and summoned demons that threatened the wilderness. Claiming his head breaks their leadership and drives back their foothold in the region. Yet corruption lingers, and the land will need watchful eyes.

faq.answer: Athrikus Narassin was an ancient and powerful warlock who led the cultists in the Tower of Althalaxx in northern Darkshore. From the spire's summit, he directed the coven's demonic rituals.
Alliance scouts watching the Tower of Althalaxx need proof that the master warlock is dead. His severed head confirms his death and the strike against the demonic forces.
Athrikus Narassin is at the summit of the Tower of Althalaxx in northern Darkshore. His devoted cultists and summoned demons guard him.

faq.q: Does killing him eliminate the demonic threat completely?
faq.answer: Athrikus Narassin's death strikes hard at the dark ritualists and scatters their current operations. Yet the demonic forces may gather again, and Darkshore will still need defense.

angles.text: As a Night Elf, you see Athrikus Narassin's death purge a demonic blight from ancient Kaldorei ruins along Kalimdor's northern shores.
As a Warlock, you know Athrikus's mastery of fel powers made him formidable. His reckless visibility in Althalaxx proved his undoing.
